query:
UPDATE copies
                     SET release_id = ?, status = ?, device_id = ?, format = ?, store_id = ?,
                         condition = ?, notes = ?, edition = ?, purchased_on = ?, price = ?,
                         currency = ?, estimated_value = ?, estimated_currency = ?,
                         barcode = ?, bundle_id = ?, updated_by = ?,
                         updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
                     WHERE id = ?
